extensionName.message: Reels Flow: Auto Scroll for Instagram Reels
extensionName.description: Full extension name shown in the browser and on the stores.

extensionShortName.description: Short extension name, also the toolbar button tooltip.

extensionDescription.message: Watch Instagram Reels hands-free: Reels Flow moves to the next Reel when the current one finishes.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and on the stores.

popupAutoScroll.description: Popup switch that turns Auto-Scroll on or off.

popupAutoScrollOn.message: Moves to the next Reel when one ends
popupAutoScrollOn.description: Popup text under Auto-Scroll while it is on.

popupAutoScrollOff.message: Off. Reels loop until you scroll
popupAutoScrollOff.description: Popup text under Auto-Scroll while it is off: Instagram replays a Reel until the viewer moves on.

popupSpeed.description: Popup switch that turns Speed on or off: while on, every Reel plays at the Preferred Speed chosen just below it.

popupSpeedOn.description: Popup text under Speed while it is on.

popupSpeedOff.message: Switch on to play Reels at $SPEED$
popupSpeedOff.description: Popup text under Speed while it is off.

popupReelControl.description: Popup switch that shows or hides the Reel Control, Reels Flow's Auto-Scroll button beside each Reel.

popupReelControlHint.message: The Auto button beside each Reel
popupReelControlHint.description: Popup text under the Button on Reels switch, describing the Reel Control.

popupReelsWatched.description: Popup label beside the count of Reels the viewer has watched in the current Session, one continuous stretch of watching the Reels Feed (instagram.com/reels/) that ends after 30 minutes with no Reel playing.

popupSessionLimit.description: Popup label of the optional Session Limit: a Break Nudge after a number of Reels or minutes in one Session, one continuous stretch of watching Instagram Reels.

popupSessionLimitOff.description: Popup choice for the Session Limit: no limit.

popupSessionLimitReels.description: Popup choice for the Session Limit: a number of Reels watched.

popupSessionLimitMinutes.description: Popup choice for the Session Limit: a number of minutes of Reels playing.

popupSessionLimitReelsValue.description: What screen readers call the Popup's number field for a Session Limit in Reels.

popupSessionLimitMinutesValue.description: What screen readers call the Popup's number field for a Session Limit in minutes.

popupSessionLimitProgressReels.description: Popup progress towards a Session Limit in Reels, in the current Session.

popupSessionLimitProgressMinutes.description: Popup progress towards a Session Limit in minutes of Reels playing, in the current Session.

popupSessionLimitLower.description: What screen readers call the Popup's minus button beside the Session Limit number.

popupSessionLimitRaise.description: What screen readers call the Popup's plus button beside the Session Limit number.

popupWhatsNew.description: Popup link to the Welcome Page on the Reels Flow website, which describes what changed in recent versions.

popupWhatsNewUnread.description: What screen readers call the dot on the Popup's What's new link, shown after an update until the viewer opens it.

popupReportProblem.description: Popup footer link to the Report Page.

popupOpenReelsFeedText.message: Reels Flow works on Instagram Reels
popupOpenReelsFeedText.description: Popup card shown when the current tab is not the Reels Feed (instagram.com/reels/), the only place Reels Flow acts. Keep "Instagram Reels" as the name of Instagram's page; never suggest Instagram made Reels Flow.

popupOpenReelsFeed.description: Button on the Popup card shown away from the Reels Feed: opens instagram.com/reels/, in the current Instagram tab or a new tab.

popupFirstRunTip.message: Open Instagram Reels and Reels Flow moves on when each Reel ends. Press $KEY$ to switch Auto-Scroll.
popupFirstRunTip.description: First-run Tip at the top of the Popup, shown until the viewer closes it. The key is the viewer's own Shortcut for Auto-Scroll on/off.

popupFirstRunTipLabel.description: What screen readers call the First-run Tip in the Popup.

popupFirstRunTipDismiss.description: What screen readers call the close (×) button on the Popup's First-run Tip. Once closed, the Tip does not come back.

reelControlName.description: What screen readers call the Reel Control, the Auto-Scroll on/off button beside each Reel.

reelControlLabel.description: Short label under the Reel Control's icon, like the counts under Instagram's own buttons.

reelControlTitle.description: Shown on hovering the Reel Control: what it does, and the Shortcut key that does the same.

popupShortcuts.description: Popup heading of the section that lists the Shortcuts, single keys that act on the Reels Feed. Clicking it opens or closes the section.

popupShortcutsHint.message: Single keys on Instagram Reels, never while you're typing. Select a key to change it.
popupShortcutsHint.description: Popup text at the top of the Shortcuts section.

shortcutToggleAutoScroll.description: Popup name of the Shortcut that switches Auto-Scroll on or off.

shortcutToggleSpeed.description: Popup name of the Shortcut that switches Speed on or off.

popupPressKey.description: Shown on a Shortcut's key in the Popup while it waits for the viewer to press its new key.

popupKeyTaken.description: Popup notice when the viewer presses a key that another Shortcut already has; the key is not taken.

popupResetShortcuts.description: Popup button that puts every Shortcut back to its default key.

popupPreferredSpeed.description: What screen readers call the Popup's slider for the Preferred Speed, how fast every Reel plays while Speed is on (0.5x to 3x).

breakNudgeTitle.description: Title of the Break Nudge, the calm notice over the Reels Feed when the viewer reaches the Session Limit they set. No guilt-trip wording.

breakNudgeText.message: You've reached the session limit you set. Keep watching, or stop here.
breakNudgeText.description: Text under the Break Nudge's title. Calm, no guilt-trip wording, no numbers or countdown.

breakNudgeKeepWatching.description: The Break Nudge's main button, also chosen by Space, Enter or Escape: the Reel plays on, and the next Break Nudge comes after another full Session Limit.

breakNudgeDone.description: The Break Nudge's other button: turns Auto-Scroll off and leaves the Reel paused.
